DendroVox, insan-bilgisayar etkileşimi v: DendroVox is an experimental research project on human-computer interaction and urban ecology awareness. Its content is generated by artificial intelligence and combines real biological facts about trees with fictional storytelling.
DendroVox bir akademik araştırma projesi: DendroVox is an academic research project. We study how people connect with nature.
İzin verirsen yazdığın mesajlar, karakte: If you agree, your messages, the character's replies and your ratings of those replies are recorded anonymously.

Üyelik, isim veya konum istemiyoruz. Ara: We don't ask for an account, your name or your location. Researchers cannot identify you; they only see pseudonymous codes.
Katılım tamamen gönüllüdür. İstersen kay: Taking part is completely voluntary. You can also chat without being recorded, and stop whenever you like.
18 yaşından küçüksen lütfen bir yetişkin: If you are under 18, please decide together with an adult.
Kayıtlar yalnızca araştırma ekibi tarafı: Records are used only by the research team for scientific analysis; reports contain only anonymous, aggregated results. You can change your decision at any time with the "Recording" button at the top of the chat screen; messages after that will not be recorded. To have earlier records deleted, you can contact the research team.

DendroVox, parklardaki ağaçlar, bitkiler: DendroVox is an experimental platform that lets you have AI-powered conversations with the trees, plants and other beings in our parks. Each one has its own personality and story.
Uygulama indirmem gerekiyor mu?: Do I need to download an app?
No, DendroVox is entirely web-based. You don't need to download an app or create an account. Just open it in your browser.
Yalnızca izin verirseniz. Sohbet başlama: Only if you allow it. You are asked before the chat starts. If you agree, conversations are stored anonymously for academic research, and details such as phone numbers and e-mail addresses are hidden automatically. If you decline, you can still chat, but nothing is recorded.
Her sohbette {n} mesaj hakkınız bulunmak: Each chat allows {n} messages. When you reach the limit, you can start a new chat.
Tabii ki hayır! DendroVox, yapay zeka ku: Of course not! DendroVox uses artificial intelligence to give trees and other beings a fictional voice. It combines scientific facts with storytelling for an educational and fun experience.
Karakterler neden havadan bahsediyor?: Why do the characters talk about the weather?
Karakterler bulundukları yerin mevsimini: Characters know the season, the time of day and the current weather where they live, so every conversation belongs to that moment.
Sesli okuma nasıl kullanılır?: How do I use read aloud?
Her cevabın altındaki \"Dinle\" düğmesin: Press the "Listen" button under any reply to hear the character's voice. Use the speaker button at the top of the chat screen to have every reply read aloud automatically; it also works well with screen readers.
Sohbet ettiğiniz her karakter Keşfet say: Every character you chat with is added to your collection on the Explore page, and you earn new badges. This is stored only in your own browser.
Evet. DendroVox isim, hesap veya konum g: Yes. DendroVox never asks for personal details such as your name, an account or your location. Records are kept anonymously, identities are replaced with pseudonymous codes in the files given to researchers, and they are used for academic purposes only.
DendroVox, modern web tarayıcısı olan tü: DendroVox works on any device with a modern web browser (phone, tablet, computer). Thanks to PWA support, you can also add it to your home screen and use it like an app.
